# Normalize to Per Minute Data
```{r}
normalize_stats <- function(df) {
  nba_start <- which(names(df) == "NBA_MIN") #split the data
  nba_end   <- which(names(df) == "PRE_G")
  
  for (i in (nba_start+1):(nba_end-1)) {
    colname <- names(df)[i]
    if (!grepl("PCT", colname, ignore.case = TRUE) && is.numeric(df[[colname]])) { #divide total columns by minute column
      df[[colname]] <- round(as.numeric(df[[colname]]) / as.numeric(df[["NBA_MIN"]]),3)
    }
  }
  pre_start <- which(names(df) == "PRE_MP")
  for (i in (pre_start+1):ncol(df)) { #repeat for college
    colname <- names(df)[i]
    if (!grepl("PCT", colname, ignore.case = TRUE) && is.numeric(df[[colname]])) {
      df[[colname]] <- round(as.numeric(df[[colname]]) / as.numeric(df[["PRE_MP"]]),3)
    }
  }
  return(df)
}
per_min_data <- normalize_stats(data)
```

```{r}
library(plotly)

data_filtered2 <- data %>%
  filter(PRE_3PA >= 25 & PRE_FTA >= 25 & NBA_FG3A >= 25)

clean_data <- na.omit(data_filtered2[c("PLAYER","NBA_FG3_PCT", "PRE_3P_PCT", "PRE_FT_PCT", "PRE_COL_or_INT")])
model <- lm(NBA_FG3_PCT ~ PRE_3P_PCT + PRE_FT_PCT, data = clean_data)
summary(model)

# Create interactive 3D scatterplot with plotly
plot_ly(clean_data, 
        x = ~PRE_3P_PCT, 
        y = ~PRE_FT_PCT, 
        z = ~NBA_FG3_PCT,
        color = ~PRE_COL_or_INT,
        colors = rainbow(length(unique(clean_data$PRE_COL_or_INT))),
        type = "scatter3d",
        mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 5),
        text = ~PLAYER,
        hoverinfo = "text+x+y+z") %>%
  layout(title = "Colored by PRE_COL_OR_INT",
         scene = list(xaxis = list(title = "Pre-3P%, >= 25 Attempts"),
                      yaxis = list(title = "Pre-FT%, >= 25 Attempts"),
                      zaxis = list(title = "NBA 3P%, >= 25 Attempts")))
```

```{r}
model <- lm(NBA_FG3_PCT ~ PRE_3P_PCT + PRE_FT_PCT, data = clean_data)

x_seq <- seq(min(clean_data$PRE_3P_PCT), max(clean_data$PRE_3P_PCT), length.out = 30)
y_seq <- seq(min(clean_data$PRE_FT_PCT), max(clean_data$PRE_FT_PCT), length.out = 30)

grid <- expand.grid(PRE_3P_PCT = x_seq, PRE_FT_PCT = y_seq)
grid$NBA_FG3_PCT <- predict(model, newdata = grid)

color_factor <- as.factor(clean_data$PRE_COL_or_INT)

plot_ly() %>%
  add_markers(
    data = clean_data,
    x = ~PRE_3P_PCT,
    y = ~PRE_FT_PCT,
    z = ~NBA_FG3_PCT,
    color = color_factor,
    marker = list(size = 4),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    text = ~paste(
      "Name:", PLAYER,
      "<br>Pre-3P%:", PRE_3P_PCT,
      "<br>Pre-FT%:", PRE_FT_PCT,
      "<br>NBA 3P%:", NBA_FG3_PCT,
      "<br>Group:", PRE_COL_or_INT
    )
  ) %>%
  add_surface(
    x = x_seq,
    y = y_seq,
    z = matrix(grid$NBA_FG3_PCT, nrow = length(x_seq), ncol = length(y_seq)),
    opacity = 0.5,
    showscale = FALSE
  ) %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "Pre-3P% (>= 25 Attempts)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Pre-FT% (>= 25 Attempts)"),
      zaxis = list(title = "NBA 3P% (>= 25 Attempts)")
    ),
    title = "Interactive 3D Regression: NBA 3P% vs Pre-3P% & Pre-FT%"
  )

```
